content.comment_body: Is anyone aware if the new [version_no] unit offers enhanced data logging compared to older releases? The promotional materials suggest improvements, but I haven’t found any detailed specifics. If anyone has example screenshots of the data logging features, could you share them?
Data logging to SD card has not changed since the [article_no] standard version.
